stepBody: Milena chooses a special form of regularization that takes in $$2$$ hyperparameters, λ and ρ. To pick the values for these parameters, she decides to use 7-fold cross validation. Milena tests $$2$$ values of λ and $$5$$ values of ρ. To estimate the optimal λ value and ρ value, how many times is each data point used to fit a model?
